title: Linkivo — Smart Link Management PWA
short_description: A sophisticated PWA for intelligent link management with a weighted discovery system, cinematic GSAP animations, and Firebase backend.
content:
Overview

Linkivo is a sophisticated Smart Link Management Progressive Web Application. Built with a Firebase backend, custom client-side routing in vanilla JavaScript, and advanced UI animations powered by GSAP, it's the most technically ambitious project in the portfolio.

Key Features

  • Cinematic Splash Screen — GSAP-powered animation where link cards converge from all directions into a padlock shape, the padlock auto-locks, and a particle burst explosion launches the app
  • Weighted Discovery System — each link has a weight/priority score; the random-discovery feature uses weighted probability so important links surface more often
  • Secure PIN Lock — DOM-hiding protection using visibility:hidden + inert attributes; PIN hashed before storage
  • Multi-layer Website Preview — iframe → OG image meta tag → screenshot API → favicon fallback cascade
  • Smart Caching — custom cache invalidation with versioned keys and selective refresh
  • Responsive Sidebar — logo acts as sidebar toggle; collapses to icon-only on small screens
  • Data Integrity — duplicate link prevention, safe delete ordering, orphan cleanup
  • Offline Support — Service Worker caching for full offline functionality

Architecture

Single-page application with custom hash-based router (no framework). All components built from scratch with zero UI dependencies. Firebase Realtime Database powers real-time sync across devices.

Tech Stack

Frontend: Vanilla JavaScript ES6+, HTML5, CSS3 Custom Properties  |  Backend: Firebase Realtime Database  |  Auth: Firebase Authentication  |  Animation: GSAP (GreenSock)  |  PWA: Service Worker, Web App Manifest  |  Hosting: Firebase Hosting
seo_title: Linkivo — Smart Link Management PWA | Muhtasim Rahman
seo_description: Progressive Web App for intelligent link management with weighted discovery, GSAP cinematic animations, secure PIN lock, and Firebase backend.

title: QR Prism — Advanced QR Code PWA

title: Project Exporter Pro
short_description: Open-source JavaScript export engine with Shadow DOM isolation. Supports PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF, and CMYK — drop into any project with zero conflicts.
content:
Overview

Project Exporter Pro is an open-source, self-contained JavaScript export engine that solves a common web developer problem: exporting DOM elements as files without style conflicts. Shadow DOM isolation means you can drop it into any existing project and it will work cleanly.

Supported Export Formats

  • PNG — lossless, with alpha channel support and DPI control
  • JPG — lossy compression with quality slider (0–100)
  • WebP — modern format with superior compression
  • SVG — scalable vector output for sharp rendering at any size
  • PDF — document-ready export with page size options
  • CMYK — print-ready color space conversion for professional printing

Key Technical Features

  • Shadow DOM Isolation — the entire engine lives in a Shadow Root; host page styles never leak in, engine styles never leak out
  • Zero External Dependencies — no npm install required; single script include
  • Live README Modal — built-in documentation accessible from the interface, no external docs needed
  • Programmatic API — call Exporter.export(element, options) from any JS code
  • Batch Export — queue multiple elements, export as individual files or single ZIP
  • Canvas Pipeline — uses html2canvas under the hood with custom optimizations

Use Cases

Certificate generators, report builders, social media card creators, design-to-file pipelines, data visualization export.

Tech Stack

Architecture: Shadow DOM v1, Web Components  |  Rendering: Canvas API, html2canvas  |  Vector: DOM-to-SVG serialization  |  Hosting: GitHub Pages
seo_title: Project Exporter Pro — Universal JavaScript Export Engine
seo_description: Open-source JS export engine with Shadow DOM isolation. PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF, CMYK. Zero style conflicts, drop into any project.

Tech Stack
